info.name: Smart Wedding Management API
info.description: Full API surface for the Smart Wedding Management backend (NestJS + Prisma). Run "1. Auth > Register" (or "Login") first — it auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken. Then run "3. Weddings > Create Wedding" to auto-save weddingId. Everything else chains off those two collection variables.

variable.description: Set manually to a second user's id for member-management requests.

request.description: Creates a new account. Change the email if you get a 409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE (email already registered).

request.description: Requires a real Google ID token from the mobile SDK / OAuth playground — cannot be exercised with a fake value.
Always returns 200. Check the backend server console log for the reset link/token (email sending is not wired up yet).
Refresh tokens are single-use and rotated — running this again with the OLD token will revoke ALL sessions (theft-detection). Always use the token this test script just saved.
